about_short_description.short_description: STEPPI is a corporate health and community engagement platform.

product.name: Virtual Challenges
product.description: A platform feature that enables organizations to create and manage activity challenges where employees track steps and physical activity remotely.

product.name: Live Leaderboards
product.description: A real-time leaderboard system that displays participant rankings and progress during activity challenges to maintain engagement and motivation.

product.name: Communication Tools
product.description: A set of pre-designed communication resources including email templates and creative assets to support challenge promotion and participant motivation.

product.name: Data and Insights Reporting
product.description: A reporting feature that provides real-time data on participation, performance, and trends to help organizations recognize achievements and manage wellness programs.

product.name: Custom Challenge Design
product.description: A feature allowing organizations to customize challenges with their branding, including logos, images, and messaging for a tailored participant experience.

product.name: Seamless Activity Tracking
product.description: Integration with multiple wearable devices and smartphones to automatically track steps and physical activity for all participants.
